keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Angel Gomes (Marseille).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aldair (Levski Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Marseille 1, Levski Sofia 0. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Penalty saved. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) right footed shot saved in the top centre of the goal by Svetoslav Vutsov (Levski Sofia).
Substitution, Marseille. Neal Maupay replaces Amine Gouiri.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Everton Bala replaces Armstrong Oko-Flex.
Álex Centelles (Levski Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Neal Maupay (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Mazire Soula replaces Aldair.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Maicon replaces Álex Centelles.
Substitution, Marseille. Amine Harit replaces Igor Paixão.
Substitution, Marseille. Tochukwu Nnadi replaces Angel Gomes.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Asen Mitkov replaces Mehdi El Moubarik.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Juan Esteban Perea Sanchez replaces Akram Bouras.
